newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK interbank rates steady on new stock issues.
newsitem.headline: HK interbank rates steady on new stock issues.

text.p: Hong Kong interbank market rates held steady on Friday because of demand for funds generated by a handful of new share issues, dealers said.
Overnight money ended at 5-1/2 7/16 percent versus 5-9/16 1/2 at Thursday midday while three-month finished unchanged at 5-1/2 percent, dealers said.
"For overnight, there's still some demand because of the four IPOs (initial public offerings) today," a dealer with a foreign bank said.
Hong Kong government bills saw good demand in line with higher prices of U.S. Treasuries overnight, dealers said.
